# Sparrow Non-Linear Photonic Sampler

The `bosonsampler` package in this directory is an unmodified copy from:

- Repository: `https://github.com/JesSparrow42/Non_Linear_Photonic_Sampler`
- Local source commit: `3cbea1f133716fae1f959198bf71a65cd7a25baf`
- Package version: `0.1.0`
- Copied: 2026-08-19

`meshvae/boson.py` is only an integration adapter. The permanent calculations,
linear Boson sampling, and quantum-dot nonlinear model remain in this package.

Set `SPARROW_BOSON_SAMPLER_PATH` or pass `--boson_sampler_path` to test a newer
checkout without replacing this fallback copy.
